subject: Re: Quick follow-up — procurement & billing requirements for pilot
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-10T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick follow-up — procurement & billing requirements for pilot

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation and excited about the pilot potential with Acme Analytics. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- Redwood will prepare a short SOW + pricing breakdown for the pilot (attached draft).
- We should confirm procurement path: PO vs. corporate card (you mentioned PO preferred).
- You asked about marketplace options (AWS Marketplace) — we can support that, but it usually takes a bit longer to onboard; direct invoicing is faster for initial pilots.
- We need billing/invoice requirements so our Finance team can format the invoice correctly (billing address, remit-to, PO number placement, tax/VAT details, preferred payment method and net terms).

Could you confirm: 
1) Will procurement issue a PO for this pilot or will the card be used?
2) If PO, who should the invoice be sent to (email + AP contact)?
3) Any special invoice fields required (PO number placement, line item breakdown, vendor legal name, EIN, VAT ID)?
4) Are you interested in moving to AWS Marketplace for the long term?

I attached a sample invoice template and the SOW draft to speed procurement review. Looping in Ben (AE) and Dev (SE) so they can help flesh out SOW/pricing and any technical onboarding notes.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this started.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
(650) 555-0123

Attachments: SOW_Draft.docx, Redwood_Invoice_Sample.pdf

From: Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-07-11T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up — procurement & billing requirements for pilot

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and the SOW draft. Procurement will need a PO for the pilot; corporate card is rarely used for pilots of this scale. A few specifics from our side: 

- We prefer net 30 terms for vendor invoices.
- Please put vendor legal name as: Redwood Inference, Inc. and include EIN on the invoice.
- Invoice should be emailed to accounts.payable@acmeanalytics.com and CC procurement@acmeanalytics.com.
- PO number must be displayed on the invoice header/first line and on each invoice line item.
- Line item breakdown is required (license, usage, support).
- For long-term purchases we are interested in AWS Marketplace (would prefer subscription via marketplace), but for the pilot we'll accept a direct invoice to speed things up.

Can you send us a W-9 (or for EU customers VAT form) and a sample invoice with the fields above populated? Also, procurement will likely request our standard vendor onboarding form — copying them to this thread.

Jordan Hayes
Head of Platform Partnerships
Acme Analytics
jordan.hayes@acmeanalytics.com
(415) 555-0147

From: Linda Park <linda.park@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-07-11T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up — procurement & billing requirements for pilot

Hi Marissa —

On behalf of Procurement, a few items we need to complete vendor setup and issue a PO: 

1) Legal vendor name and address (for PO & tax forms) — please confirm the exact legal name and remit-to address.
2) Vendor tax documentation: W-9 (US) or VAT registration (EU) as applicable.
3) Sample invoice (PDF) showing required fields: PO number, invoice number, date, line item breakdown, tax line (if any), total amount, vendor EIN.
4) Payment methods: ACH preferred. If you accept wire, include bank details and SWIFT.
5) If you plan to use AWS Marketplace for future purchases, indicate whether billing will be via Marketplace or direct.
6) Our standard onboarding spreadsheet is attached — please fill in and return so we can expedite P.O. issuance.

Procurement timeline note: once we have the completed onboarding and tax docs, expect a PO within ~5 business days. For pilots we sometimes process a one-time invoice; for recurring work we prefer a monthly invoice tied to a PO.

Thanks,
Linda Park
Procurement Manager
Acme Analytics
PROC_PO_TEMPLATE.xlsx attached
accounts.payable@acmeanalytics.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@acmeanalytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-13T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up — procurement & billing requirements for pilot

Hi Jordan / Linda —

Thanks for the details — looping in Finance to make sure we provide everything cleanly. Quick answers from our side: 

- Legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Remit-to (for invoice header): 1200 Redwood Ave, Suite 400, Palo Alto, CA 94301
- EIN: 27-1234567 (we will send a signed W-9 as attachment)
- We can support net 30; monthly invoices are fine.
- Invoice format: PDF with PO # in the top-right and repeated on each line; line item breakout into: Pilot license, Usage tokens, Support.
- Payment: ACH preferred; bank details will be provided on the invoice or via secure portal.
- AWS Marketplace: happy to support — for the pilot we recommend direct invoice to avoid onboarding delays; we can start Marketplace onboarding in parallel.

Attached: W9_Redwood.pdf, Redwood_Invoice_Sample.pdf, SOW_Draft.docx. Ben will own delivering a finalized SOW and pricing sheet by Friday 7/17.

Action items: 
- Jordan/Linda: confirm PO timeline and whether you want us to populate the Procurement spreadsheet.
- Marissa/Ben: finalize and send completed onboarding + signed W-9.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
(650) 555-0199

From: Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Linda Park <linda.park@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-07-15T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up — procurement & billing requirements for pilot

Thanks Ben — that all looks good. A couple quick confirmations: 

- We will issue a PO for the pilot; procurement expects to issue PO by 2026-07-20 after they receive the completed onboarding spreadsheet and W-9.
- Please send the finalized SOW and a single consolidated invoice template (PDF) we can use to validate fields.
- Invoice should be sent to: accounts.payable@acmeanalytics.com (please CC procurement@acmeanalytics.com).
- We prefer ACH payment; please include ACH routing and account details in the vendor onboarding or the invoice (securely).

Also confirming interest in AWS Marketplace for longer term procurement — we will discuss internally once pilot pricing and usage patterns are clear. For now, PO path is the immediate route.

Jordan
